解耦设计：仅生成tool_name+指令列表，JSONL生成由data-generator完成

bug-data-generator 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Automatically generates training data to fix bugs based on user-provided bug descriptions and error causes.
- Parses bug description to identify correct tools, generate triggering user instruction sets, and utilizes data-generator to output JSONL training data.
- Supports natural language commands for generating batch training data tailored to specific bugs.
- Customizes output formats and user instruction templates according to bug characteristics and intended tool usage.
